# Copilot Instructions

Read [`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) first. It is the canonical operating guide for architecture, policy evidence, remediation safety, workflow, and validation.

Use its read-first references instead of maintaining a second set of project rules here. In particular:

- `README.md` — purpose and normal entry points
- `REPRODUCIBILITY.md` — setup, validation, and evaluation
- `docs/architecture/current-baseline.md` — current architecture
- `docs/frontend_backend_contract.md` — API/frontend invariants
- `docs/benchmark_context.md` — benchmark mappings and remediation tiers
- `docs/thesis_context.md` and `outputs/README.md` — research evidence and claim limits

Do not invent missing architecture, duplicate configuration defaults in prose, or treat historical artifacts as current runtime contracts.
